dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Bills (9-1) Week 12 Briefing: Thursday Injury Report Ahead of Chiefs
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: CB Christian Benford (groin), LB Dorian Williams (calf), and TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb / ankle) logged limited practice reps Thursday [buffalobills.com Official](https://www.buffalobills.com/news/buffalo-bills-injury-report-vs-chiefs-week-12-thanksgiving).

Week 12 Chiefs Outlook: Joe Brady and DC Jim Leonhard open installation for the Kansas City Chiefs (8-2, BUF -3, HC Andy Reid, OC Eric Bieniemy & DC Steve Spagnuolo (Highmark Stadium))—a unit ranked #1 in Total Yards / Game (396.9 yds) as Buffalo prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [ProFootballTalk](https://www.nbcsports.com/watch/nfl/profootballtalk/pft-pm/pft-week-12-preview-2026-kansas-city-chiefs-vs-buffalo-bills) [Nick Suss](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50596159/bills-kincaid-benford-5-starters-listed-questionable).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 9-1 (1st in AFC East • #1 Seed in AFC), Buffalo carries a 99.9% postseason projection, 98.8% AFC East division title mark, and 53.3% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Sara Larson](https://www.buffalorumblings.com/buffalo-bills-scores-results/146289/buffalo-bills-week-11-game-balls-greg-rousseau-and-james-cook-reach-career-milestones).

Around the Beat: The Buffalo Bills have ruled no one out for Thursday night [Rachel Auberger](https://www.buffalorumblings.com/buffalo-bills-injuries/146344/bills-have-options-chiefs-have-absences-ahead-of-thanksgiving-showdown).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Buffalo ranks #2 in Points / Game (31.3), #9 in Points Allowed / Game (20.8), #18 in Turnover Differential (-1), giving Joe Brady and Jim Leonhard a clear benchmark ahead of Thu, Nov 26, 8:20 PM EST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Kansas City Chiefs [Joe Buscaglia](https://bsky.app/profile/joebuscaglia.bsky.social/post/3n35eubm3ek2h).
